feed.titleEn: GCCs Are Mistaking AI Adoption for AI Advantage
feed.titleKo: GCC는 AI 채택을 AI 이점으로 착각하고 있음
feed.desc: GCCs Are Mistaking AI Adoption for AI Advantage    Nasscom
feed.descEn: By Vagesha Sinha, AVP – GCC Practice
feed.summary:
The bottleneck is no longer AI adoption but it is industry’s habit of treating visible AI activity as proof of enterprise advantage.
Advantage shows up when a GCC can prove that its data moved a recurring business decision faster, better, or more profitably than before.
According to AI-first Global Capability Centers Index 2026 , AI is used by almost all surveyed Indian GCCs, yet meaningful business impact remains elusive for nearly two-thirds of the industry.

장점은 GCC가 데이터가 반복적인 비즈니스 결정을 이전보다 더 빠르고, 더 좋게, 더 수익성 있게 움직였다는 것을 증명할 수 있을 때 나타남

feed.titleEn: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026
feed.titleKo: 2026년에 글로벌 AI 투자가 1조 달러를 넘을 것으로 예상됨
feed.desc: Global AI Investment Is Forecast to Exceed $1 Trillion in 2026    Goldman Sachs
feed.descEn: Goldman Sachs Research adjusted widely cited measures of capital expenditure by US hyperscale tech companies to develop a more comprehensive estimate of AI investment around the world.
feed.summary:
That projection points to $1 trillion of AI-related investment around the globe in 2026, including $581 billion in the US, writes Joseph Briggs, who co-leads the Global Economics team, in a report.
There is also some risk of double-counting capex for AI for some companies that do not report property, plant, and equipment investment separately from financial leases in their capex statements.
Those estimates imply that AI capex will rise from 1.8% of GDP in the US (with global AI investment totaling 0.9% of global GDP) in 2026 to 2.5% of GDP in the US (1.3% globally) in 2027, with a further increase to 2.8% (1.4% globally) in 2028.

That's a 213% jump since the previous quarter, and driven largely by the big compute deal it signed with Anthropic that was a big part of its $1.6 billion in revenue from "AI infrastructure."

feed.descEn: Bank of America says AI infrastructure financing remains robust as demand grows across data centers, power and compute.
feed.summary:
Bank of America has a “robust” pipeline across the three key pillars of data center development – buildings, power supply and compute equipment – according to Karen Fang, global head of infrastructure and sustainable finance.
For example, AI training tasks can be shifted to regions experiencing surplus renewable generation and scaled back in areas facing power constraints.
Over time, improved efficiency could reduce the need for additional power generation capacity, lower operating costs, and help address community concerns about the energy footprint of large-scale data center projects.

feed.desc: AI Server Shipments Forecast Raised to Nearly 31% YoY in 2026 as 90% Surge in CSP CapEx Fuels Infrastructure Expansion, Says TrendForce    TrendForce
feed.descEn: Surging investment in AI infrastructure is expected to drive the combined CapEx of the world’s nine largest CSPs up by approximately 90% YoY in 2026, according to TrendForce’s latest AI server research.
feed.summary:
TrendForce estimates that the combined 2026 CapEx of Google, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu will exceed US$886.7 billion, with the five North American hyperscalers accounting for nearly 90%.
TrendForce has therefore revised its 2026 AI server shipment forecast upward from 28% to nearly 31% YoY.
Looking to 2027, TrendForce estimates that the combined CapEx of the top nine CSPs will hit about $1.3 trillion, showing nearly 50% year-over-year growth.

feed.desc: WHO and ITU launch AI initiative to expand digital support for noncommunicable disease care    Tech Review Africa
feed.descEn: Your Trusted Tech News Platform
feed.summary:
According to project partners, artificial intelligence will support the design and delivery of more personalized digital health interventions while helping health systems expand their capacity to provide preventive care and behavioural support.
Through BHBM 2.0, WHO and ITU aim to demonstrate how responsible AI adoption can strengthen public health systems, improve access to healthcare information and support individuals in making healthier lifestyle choices.
The joint initiative, known as BHBM 2.0 , aims to use AI-driven solutions to strengthen digital health services and address gaps in the delivery of behavioural interventions for people affected by or at risk of noncommunicable diseases.

Worldwide end-user spending on AI models and platforms is projected to total US$64 billion in 2026, up 63.4 per cent from US$39 billion in 2025, with more and more enterprises are choosing to work with companies that can provide clear value.

feed.desc: Citi fuels growth for Taiwan companies in AI boom    Taipei Times
feed.descEn: As a global race to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure reshapes investment flows and supply chains, Citigroup Inc is positioning Taiwan as a key market in its strategy to capture rising demand for cross-border banking, capital markets and advisory services.The US banking giant sees Ta
feed.summary:
The US banking giant sees Taiwan’s central role in semiconductor manufacturing and the broader AI ecosystem as a long-term growth opportunity, as companies expand overseas, restructure supply chains and seek financing for the next wave of technology investment, Marc Luet, Citi’s Head of Japan, Asia North & Australia Cluster and Banking, said in Taipei on Thursday last week.
Taiwan’s AI-driven expansion has already accelerated overseas investment by local companies seeking to diversify production, move closer to customers and strengthen supply-chain resilience, while maintaining high-value research and semiconductor capabilities at home.
Citi estimates global capital expenditure related to AI could reach US$7.75 trillion by 2030, driven not only by demand for AI chips, but also by the broader infrastructure required to support the technology, including data centers, advanced manufacturing and energy systems.

feed.summary:
This is evident in the rise of dedicated Centers of Excellence within Indian GCCs, with a majority now operating formal innovation teams or CoEs focused on emerging industry evolution and technology adoption rather than maintenance.

Tijani said he looks forward to working with fellow commissioners to advance practical AI solutions that can accelerate sustainable development and deliver meaningful social and economic impact worldwide.
Nigeria’s Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, Bosun Tijani, has been inaugurated as a founding member of the AI for Good Global Commission, a new high-level international body established by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) to promote trusted, inclusive and globally coordinated approaches to artificial intelligence.

feed.descEn: As AI reshapes roles, 60% of organizations will restructure into smaller teams by 2029, the analyst firm said.
feed.summary:
By 2029, 60% of organizations will implement smaller software engineering teams , up from 15% in 2026, according to projections published this week by Gartner.
With the shift toward smaller, more specialized teams, Camacho added that hiring junior talent is especially important.
Camacho said the strategy is ideal for organizations with product operating models, rather than project-based structures, working in conjunction with platform engineering teams that provide workflows and support for the smaller units.
